card.title: I Told You Enough
card.instruction: Agree to be honest while repeatedly narrowing what honesty requires and which details count.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll be honest about your missing donation box. You asked where I went; I said the bank.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you take the box there?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. You didn't ask what was inside.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Was the money still in it when you arrived?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At the car park, yes. If you mean the counter, that's a different arrival.

mechanism: A agrees to honesty but keeps subdividing the scope and timing of what counts as an answered question.
confusable: Unlike refusing to answer, A supplies narrow truths that force B to ask ever more precisely.
comparison: Bank arrival becomes car park versus counter; the dinner alternative subdivides the meaning of eating alone.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
